decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

Site Location Plan, 706 . P . 02 P3, 706 . P . 03 P3, 706 . P . 04 P3, 706 . P . 05 P3, 706 . P . 06 P3, 706 . P . 07 P4, 706 . P . 08 P3, 706 . P . 09 P3

Design and Access Statement P3, Comfort Cooling Information, Basement Impact Assessment (JH1955), Tree Survey Sheets, Arboricultural Impact Assessment (SHA 2002), SHA 2002 TSP, Noise Impact Assessment 

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new glazed elements shall accurately replicate, in terms of material (aluminium 
framed), profile, fenestration pattern and detailing, their replacement original unit. 
Prior to the commencement of development, details shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The required details shall include a 1:20 scale elevation drawing of each window type (existing and proposed) with sections at 1:10. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the building and the character of the area 
in accordance with policies D1 and D2 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 4 - Prior to the commencement of development, the following details shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority:

a) Through wall section details at 1:10 showing build-up depth 

b) Material specifications for the new render applied to the new lift shaft (and used for isolated repairs). 

c) A section detail at 1:10 showing the 75mm shadow gap and how this will be junction will connect the extension into the main built form.  

d) A sample panel of the proposed render showing a matching colour and texture 
to be provided on site prior to application to ensure it is an accurate match to the main building. 

Reason:  To safeguard the appearance of the building and the character of the 
area in accordance with policies D1 and D2 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 5 - All existing historic features including, but not limited to the, glazed balconies, 
screens, louvers, canopies, blocks, and metal staircases, balustrades, and niche, 
shall be retained in their existing position and fully protected during the course of 
works on site.  

If repairs are identified that require features to be taken off site, the associated 
structural report demonstrating the material failings and the scope of repairs shall 
firstly be submitted to the Local Planning Authority. The report should include a 
methodology for repair and timeframe for reinstatement. No fabric shall be 
removed from site unless the repairs methodology is firstly confirmed.  

Reason:  To safeguard the appearance of the building and the character of the 
area in accordance with policies D1 and D2 of the Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 6 - The works hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the methods 
outlined in the submitted Arboricultural Impact Assessment (Sharon Hosegood 
Assoc, SHA 2002). 

Reason: To ensure that the development will not have an adverse impact on 
existing trees and in order to maintain the character and amenity of the area in 
accordance policies A2 and A3 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 7 - The development shall not be carried out other than in strict accordance with the 
methodologies, recommendations and requirements of the Basement Impact 
Assessment (Jensen Hunt Design, JH1955)  hereby approved, and the 
confirmation at the detailed design stage that the damage impact assessment 
would be limited to Burland Category 1.

Reason: To ensure proper consideration of the structural stability of neighbouring 
buildings and to safeguard the appearance and character of the immediate area in 
accordance with the requirements of policies D1, D2 and A5 of the London 
Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 8 - The development hereby approved shall not commence until such time as a 
suitably qualified chartered engineer with membership of the appropriate 
professional body has been appointed to inspect, check for compliance with the 
design (as approved by the local planning authority and building control body) and 
monitor the critical elements of both permanent and temporary basement 
construction works throughout their duration. Details of the appointment and the 
appointee's responsibilities shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the 
local planning authority prior to the commencement of development. Any 
subsequent change or reappointment shall be confirmed forthwith for the duration 
of the construction works. 

Reason: To ensure proper consideration of the structural stability of neighbouring 
buildings and to safeguard the appearance and character of the immediate area in 
accordance with the requirements of policies D1, D2 and A5 of the London 
Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 9 - The external noise level emitted from plant, machinery or equipment at the devel-opment
with specified noise mitigation hereby approved shall be lower than the 
typical existing background noise level by at least 10dBA, by 15dBA where the 
source is tonal, as assessed according to BS4142:2014 at the nearest and/or most 
affected noise sensitive premises, with machinery operating at maximum capacity 
and thereafter be permanently retained.

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/ sur-rounding
premises is not adversely affected by noise from mechanical installa-tions/
equipment in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the 
London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017
Condition : 10 - Prior to use, machinery, plant or equipment at the development shall be mounted 
with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration isolated 
from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such. 

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site and 
surrounding premises is not adversely affected by vibration in accordance with the 
requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 
2017
description: Removal of existing roof light. Erection of two storey side extension incorporating lift. Replacement of front boundary vehicular and pedestrian entrance gates, replacement windows and associated external works and plant
